item.description: NASA's Curiosity rover has been collecting data about Mars' thin, carbon dioxide–rich atmosphere since 2012. However, detecting small pH differences inside the body remains challenging because magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) signals are affected by the concentration of the imaging agent used. Fuente: Phys.org.
